name: Doppler Volume Rendering
aliases: Spectral Volume Rendering with Doppler Effect
definition: A volume rendering technique that accounts for the Doppler effect of light by employing spectral volume rendering in an emission-absorption model, where volumetric matter moves according to a 3D velocity field and emits/attenuates light at wavelengths subject to Doppler shifts, using a novel piecewise linear spectral representation to achieve interactive frame rates.
summary: Doppler Volume Rendering simulates the Doppler effect on volumetric matter by using a piecewise linear spectral representation to produce physically accurate color shifts based on 3D velocity fields.
